main_finding: The concrete SDD-style HWB certificate is semantically exact on the frozen finite scope, but it did not beat the best exact OBDD on the overlapping n<=8 range. Published asymptotic SDD-vs-OBDD succinctness results remain external prior art and are not substituted for measured JANUS compiler cost.

external_prior_art.claim: HWB has exponential OBDD size for any variable ordering
external_prior_art.source: Graph driven BDDs — a new data structure for Boolean functions, TCS 141 (1995)

external_prior_art.claim: HWB admits polynomial-size uncompressed SDD; generalized HWB yields exponential compressed-SDD vs OBDD separation
external_prior_art.source: Bova, SDDs Are Exponentially More Succinct than OBDDs, AAAI 2016

next_objective: Remove oracle family labels. JANUS receives only a frozen typed/CNF state, pays detection/language/structure-selection cost, and must choose a representation package whose total certified representation cost is compared with oracle-best only for evaluation.
